questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

He do not / fear the / repercussions of / this decision.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the incorrect verb form "**do**" instead of "**does**."
 
• For the third person singular (he, she, it), the correct form of the verb **"do" is "does."**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**He does not**," ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He** does not fear** the repercussions of this decision."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "repercussions of"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "fear the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "this decision."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. (Ø = No article)

_____ road to Taj Mahal passes through ___ forest.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the definite article "**the**" is used before** "road to Taj Mahal" **to specify a particular road.
 
• The indefinite article "**a**" is used before** "forest" **because it refers to any general forest.
 
• Using "the" before "road" makes the sentence clear and specific because it refers to a known or identifiable road to the Taj Mahal.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** ***The** road to Taj Mahal passes through** a **forest.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: “A; a” would be incorrect because the use of "a" before "road" does not specify a particular road to the Taj Mahal.
 
• **Option 3**: “A; the” would place incorrect emphasis, making "forest" too specific when it should be general.
 
• **Option 4**: “Ø; Ø” would make the sentence improper as articles are needed for clarity and correctness.

questions.question:

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mumbai is the city of dreams but it is** an **expensive city too."*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

He passed away __in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July__.

options.text: at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950
in the year 1950 on 13 July at 10 a.m.
in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July
on 13 July at 10 a.m. in the year 1950

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950"** means specifying the exact time, date, and year when an event occurred. (1950 में 13 जुलाई को सुबह 10 बजे)

 
 
• **Example: **He was born at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950.
 
 
 
• The correct phrase **"at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950"** is the most appropriate and correctly ordered way to specify the time, date, and year. (1950 में 13 जुलाई को सुबह 10 बजे)
 
 
• **Example: **She graduated at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2** (1950 में 13 जुलाई को सुबह 10 बजे): It is correct but not the most standard way of structuring the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** He got married in the year 1950 on 13 July at 10 a.m.
 
 
 
• **Option 3** (1950 में 13 जुलाई को सुबह 10 बजे): It is also correct but less preferred in formal contexts.
 
 
• **Example: **They moved to a new city in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July.
 
 
 
• **Option 4** (1950 में 13 जुलाई को सुबह 10 बजे): This is the most logically and grammatically incorrect option.
 
 
• **Example:** The event was held on 13 July at 10 a.m. in the year 1950.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

__At his wit’s end__, he decided to return to his parents as he was unable to cope with the stress of adjusting at a new place.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"At his wit’s end"** means being so worried or confused by a problem that you do not know what to do next. (समझ में न आना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **at her wit's en**d trying to figure out how to fix the computer.
 
 
 
• **"Not knowing what to do"** refers to a state of confusion or indecision, similar to being at one's wit's end. (क्या करना है यह न जानते हुए)
 
 
• **Example: **Not knowing what to do, he sat down and started to think deeply about his next steps.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **'At his wit’s end'** can be substituted with **'Not knowing what to do'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Taking all notes** (सभी नोट्स लेना): The act of making written notes of important information.

 
 
• **Example:** Taking all notes during the lecture helped him prepare for the exam.
 
 
 
• **After thinking** (सोचने के बाद): Following a period of thought or consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** After thinking for a while, she decided to accept the job offer.
 
 
 
• **Deciding after contemplation** (विचार करने के बाद निर्णय लेना): Making a decision after careful thought or consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** Deciding after contemplation, he chose to move to a new city.
